essence: Arjuna seeks a decisive resolution between two praised paths.
Action-yoga is superior and necessary for renunciation; both together bestow the highest good.
The renouncer free from dualities and mental desire and aversion is easily liberated from bondage.
sankhya and yoga are one recognition, not two rival paths
sankhya and yoga are one recognition, not separate disciplines
